purpose: Provide current product-level completion interpretation while preserving prior packet, phase, exact-subject and subsystem evidence as immutable historical boundaries.
rules: Prior completion ledgers remain immutable historical/boundary evidence and may not dispatch current work when they conflict with CURRENT-AUTHORITY.
A completed packet, phase, branch, hosted qualification, A-01 receipt, subsystem or integration slice does not by itself make its owning active system complete.
SYSTEM-COMPLETION-STATUS-001 controls current whole-system completion standing.
SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK and DOCUMENTS remain incomplete and active until explicit product-level completion authority changes their standing.
PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired. There is no remaining Prose product work and no active Prose execution domain.
Any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability is BOOK-owned integration and does not reopen or reactivate Prose.
Historical completion evidence never transfers PASS across a changed SHA, topology, integration subject, ownership boundary or qualification class.

Finish shared Foundation/Spine and integration/runtime/data/platform/continuity/assurance/A-01 primitives; administer Knowledge Recovery without taking peer-system or Programming product semantics.

support_programs.job: Recover and prove Programming source/custody/provenance first, then remaining authorized catalog/archive evidence, without redefining topology or replacing Programming engineering work.

interpretation_rule: For detailed prior completion evidence read historical_boundary_ledgers; for current whole-system and retirement claims use this ledger with system_completion_status and CURRENT-AUTHORITY, with current authority controlling conflicts.
